verdict.rationale: vLLM's evidence describes a local or self-hosted inference engine that serves models through an OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing shows it connecting to or routing requests to cloud AI providers alongside local models in one interface. Its OpenAI-compatible server lets outside clients talk to vLLM, which is the opposite direction and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
